claim_one_line: L130 -- IS THE THINNING LAW A LAW? OUTCOME SPECIAL against a criterion sealed and pushed BEFORE compute, with the prior disclosed as SPECIAL and LAW named as the convenient answer needing the higher bar; IT DID NOT CLEAR IT. Banked-identity gate PASSED (B946's V-table factorisations reproduced inside the pipeline before any new number was read); vacuity exclusion set EMPTY (no family had total prime support <= 3), so the pre-declared exclusion rule could not have shaped the result. THE TEST, normalisation-free: for each banked value family take the integer-primitive minimal polynomial and ask whether the EXTREME coefficients are thin (|support| <= 2 each) while at least one extra prime lives ONLY in the middle. RESULT 5 of 7: V (lead {953}, const {2,3}, mid-only 13/17/1129/421493), W (lead {953}, const {5}, mid-only 3/367/677), d_S (lead {2,3}, const {953}, mid-only 5/11/35257), d_A (lead {2,3}, const {953}, mid-only 23) and m_S (lead {2,3}, const {20417473}, mid-only 11/71/151/349) HOLD; mu_charge (lead {2,3,5,7,11}, const {13}) and kappa_compact (lead {2,3,5,7,11,31}, const {19}) FAIL, both with EMPTY mid-only sets and fat leading coefficients. WHERE THE SEAL WAS IMPRECISE, AND WHAT IS NOT BANKED: the prereg's SPECIAL branch read 'then V is special, the thinning is about V alone, and B946's phrasing must be narrowed TO V' -- but FIVE families hold the pattern, not one, so that GLOSS IS NOT WHAT THE DATA SAYS. The criterion (>= 1 live failure => SPECIAL) fired correctly and its verdict stands, but its editorial description of what SPECIAL would mean was written too crudely at seal time, and this seat does NOT bank a conclusion the computation contradicts. Honoring the commitment, B946's law-shaped phrasing IS narrowed: the thinning is NOT a law over the value layer as B946's LAW_MAP row implied, and what replaces it is scoped to the five families that hold it with the two failures named. THE POST-HOC OBSERVATION, FLAGGED AND NOT CLAIMED: the 5/2 split is not scattered -- the five that hold are the VALUE families (hierarchy, mixing overlap, the two twists, the flip mass) and the two that fail are the PENCIL CUBICS (mu charge, kappa compact), structural/geometric objects rather than value families, failing in the SAME way (fat leading coefficient, empty mid-only). This was seen AFTER the results and is therefore POST-HOC; it is registered as L137, not claimed, and if real it needs its own sealed cell with the value/pencil partition declared IN ADVANCE -- which this cell could not do, having declared only a per-family pass/fail. The temptation is explicit in the findings: re-describing SPECIAL as 'the thinning law holds on the value layer and fails on the pencils' would convert a failed prediction into a success story, which is post-hoc rescue and exactly what the seal exists to prevent. LIMITS: the pattern's definition was fixed in the seal and is one reasonable formalisation of 'thin extremes, fat middle', though no family here is borderline (the two failures have EMPTY mid-only sets and leading supports of size 5 and 6); seven families is a small sample and no significance claim is made; and B946's EXACT ARITHMETIC (e3/lambda^4 = 27, lambda forced, the degree-graded residue for V) is UNTOUCHED -- only the generalisation from V to the value layer is narrowed.
